solo.summary: A smile you didn't plan opens a door today.
solo.full_text: The stars line up for the unforced version of you. Skip the strategy and let warmth lead — a light hello in an ordinary moment could turn into something. Eye contact lasts a beat longer than usual today. Let it.

cats.name: Confession
cats.comment: Honesty lands softer than you think

solo.summary: Say the small thing you keep swallowing.
solo.full_text: Venus rewards the first move today, not the perfect one. That compliment you're rehearsing? Just send it. Someone has been waiting for a sign that you're open, and today you're finally giving off that frequency.

solo.summary: Slow down — the good one is easy to miss when rushing.
solo.full_text: Today isn't about chasing; it's about noticing. The person who's kind in a forgettable way is worth a second look. Let the loud sparks fade and the quiet ones show themselves. Your intuition is unusually sharp tonight.

cats.name: New Connections
cats.comment: Look twice at the quiet one

solo.summary: You're magnetic today, and you don't even have to try.
solo.full_text: Leo-bright energy surrounds you. You'll catch someone watching when you least expect it. Wear the color you feel good in and say yes to the plan you'd normally skip — that's where the spark is hiding today.

cats.name: New Connections
cats.comment: Say yes to the last-minute plan

solo.summary: An old contact resurfaces with new energy.
solo.full_text: The Wheel turns and someone from your past drifts back into view. It doesn't mean rewind — it means a fresh angle. Reply if it feels light. Curiosity, not nostalgia, is your compass today.

solo.summary: Your people-radar is on point today.
solo.full_text: You'll read a room correctly and it'll save you time. Someone flirty but flaky shows their pattern early — trust it. Meanwhile a slower, steadier person is quietly hoping you notice them. You will if you look up from your phone.

solo.summary: A shared laugh does more than any pickup line.
solo.full_text: The Sun favors joy today. Wherever you're laughing, someone is drawn in. Don't overthink the follow-up — the moment itself is the opener. A café or a bookstore holds a small, bright chance.

solo.summary: Being fully yourself is the whole strategy today.
solo.full_text: No filter needed. The version of you that geeks out about your weird interest is exactly the one that catches someone's eye. Authenticity is loud today in the best way. Let your real self take the lead.

solo.summary: Say yes to the invite you'd normally decline.
solo.full_text: Today's luck lives just outside your routine. That gathering you're lukewarm on is where a new face is waiting. Comfort zones are cozy but empty of surprises — step one foot out and the stars do the rest.

solo.summary: Patience is quietly working in your favor.
solo.full_text: The Hermit says the alone-time you've had wasn't wasted — it sharpened what you actually want. You'll recognize the right kind of person faster now. No forcing today; the right connection arrives when you stop auditioning for the wrong ones.

some.full_text: The tension of 'are we or aren't we' finally tips your way. A slightly bolder text, a plan with an actual date on it — small moves land well today. They're more into it than they let on. Give them a reason to admit it.

cats.name: Progress
cats.comment: One brave text moves it forward

some.summary: Stop decoding and just ask what you want to know.
some.full_text: Mercury favors directness today. The endless analysis of their last message is stealing your peace. A simple, warm question cuts through the fog and — surprise — they answer honestly. Clarity is closer than you fear.

some.summary: Match their energy — don't outrun it.
some.full_text: Temperance is today's card: balance beats intensity. If you pour twice as much in, it tips over. Mirror their pace and the connection steadies. The chemistry is real; it just needs even footing, not a sprint.

some.summary: A little mystery makes them lean in today.
some.full_text: You don't have to reveal every card. Being warm but not fully available makes them curious in the best way. Answer, then go live your life. The pull works both directions today — let them do some of the reaching.

some.summary: Their guard drops if you go first.
some.full_text: The Magician says your move sets the tone. A small piece of honesty — 'I liked seeing you' — gives them permission to match it. They've been waiting for safety, not pressure. Offer the first bit of realness today.

some.summary: Read the voice, not just the text.
some.full_text: The Moon warns that written words lose tone today. If something feels off, a call clears it in a minute. Don't build a story out of a period at the end of a sentence. Hear them and the doubt dissolves.

Today favors the concrete. Vague 'we should hang out' becomes real when you name a day. They'll say yes faster than you expect — the hesitation was never about you, just the fog of no plan. Make it specific.

cats.name: Progress
cats.comment: Name a day, seal the plan

some.summary: Confidence is your best outfit today.
some.full_text: The Sun lifts your whole vibe. When you're relaxed and sure of yourself, they mirror it. Skip the anxious double-texting — one good message from a settled place does more than five from a spiral. Let ease lead.

some.summary: Today's the day to gently define things.
some.full_text: You're allowed to want clarity. A low-pressure 'so, what is this?' feels scary but the stars back honesty today. Whatever the answer, you win — either it deepens or it frees you. Ambiguity has an expiration date.

some.summary: Small consistency beats one grand gesture.
some.full_text: Forget the big romantic move today. The daily good-morning, the remembering a small detail — that's what makes them fall. Steady warmth is your superpower now. Show up in the little ways and watch it click.

couple.summary: A tiny act of care warms the whole day.
couple.full_text: The Empress smiles on the small stuff. Bringing them their favorite snack, remembering the thing they mentioned once — today those land bigger than any grand gesture. Softness is your love language now, and it's fluent.

couple.summary: Say the appreciation out loud today.
couple.full_text: The things you assume they know? Say them anyway. A specific 'I love how you...' hits different today. Gratitude spoken out loud strengthens the bond more than a whole planned date. Let them hear it.

cats.name: Date Vibes
cats.comment: A simple night in feels golden

couple.summary: Plan something small and just for you two.
couple.full_text: Routine's been running the show — today break it gently. A short walk, a new café, anything off-script rekindles the spark. You don't need a big event; you need a little novelty shared. The stars favor spontaneity tonight.

couple.summary: Listen first — they need to feel heard today.
couple.full_text: The High Priestess urges quiet attention. If they seem off, don't fix it, just hear it. Today your patience is the gift. A small worry aired and received keeps a molehill from becoming a mountain later.

cats.name: Replies
cats.comment: They open up if you listen

couple.summary: You're in sync — enjoy the easy day.
couple.full_text: The Lovers card glows over you two today. Things just flow: same jokes, same cravings, same energy. Don't overthink it, just soak it in. This is the kind of ordinary-good day you'll miss when it's busy again.

couple.summary: One honest sentence prevents a week of tension.
couple.full_text: Justice favors saying the small true thing today, kindly. Swallowed feelings ferment; aired ones clear. If something's been nagging you, a calm 'hey, can we talk about...' goes far better than you fear. Balance is restored by honesty.

cats.name: Date Vibes
cats.comment: Clear air makes room for fun

couple.summary: Reassurance is the whole gift today.
couple.full_text: The Moon makes emotions run a little high. A small 'we're good, right?' from either side settles things fast. Don't let a quiet mood turn into a silent story. A warm word tonight is worth more than usual.

couple.summary: Do the boring thing together and make it fun.
couple.full_text: Groceries, errands, the un-glamorous stuff — today it's secretly romantic when shared. The Star says intimacy hides in the mundane. Turn a chore into a duet and you'll feel closer than any fancy dinner could manage.

couple.summary: Surprise them with something tiny and specific.
couple.full_text: It's not the size, it's the aim. A snack they mentioned once, a song that's 'yours' — today the specific little thing proves you pay attention. The Empress rewards attentive love. Small, precise, and today, powerful.

couple.summary: Protect a pocket of just-us time today.
couple.full_text: The world's noisy and it's pulling at both of you. Carve out even thirty phone-free minutes tonight. The World card says what you've built deserves tending, not just maintaining. Presence is the practice today.

rebound.summary: A cool, steady head is your best look today.
rebound.full_text: The Strength card favors composure over longing. If your mind keeps drifting back, let it settle before you act. A calm, unbothered energy is far more magnetic to them than any desperate reach. Steady wins today.

rebound.summary: Closure with yourself comes before any reunion.
rebound.full_text: Judgement asks you to be honest about what actually happened, not the softened memory. When you see it clearly, you'll know whether to reach out or release. Either way, today brings a lighter, truer feeling.

rebound.summary: If you reach out, keep it light and pressure-free.
rebound.full_text: Should you message them, let it be easy — no essays, no blame. A small, warm 'thought of you' opens more than a heavy talk. The Star favors gentle hope today. Low stakes, open door, no demands.

rebound.summary: Letting go a little is what draws them back.
rebound.full_text: Death, the card of endings-as-beginnings, is oddly on your side. Loosening your grip today changes the whole energy. When you stop bracing for the past, room opens for something new — with them, or with someone better.

cats.name: Reunion
cats.comment: Loosen the grip, gain the pull

rebound.summary: Focus on your own glow-up today.
rebound.full_text: The Sun says the best move toward reunion is looking away from it. Pour today into yourself — the hobby, the friends, the routine. That light is what they miss. Become the person they regret losing, for you first.

rebound.summary: Don't rewrite the ending in your head today.
rebound.full_text: The Moon blurs memory into something rosier than it was. Before you idealize the reunion, remember the real reasons. If the pull survives an honest look, it might be worth it. If not, that clarity is a gift too.

cats.name: Lingering Feelings
cats.comment: See it as it really was

rebound.summary: A chance encounter is possible — stay open, not anxious.
rebound.full_text: The Wheel of Fortune hints at an unplanned crossing today. If it happens, be warm and unhurried, not overeager. Let it be a small, kind moment rather than a make-or-break scene. Ease is your ally.

rebound.summary: Silence can say more than another message.
rebound.full_text: The Hermit suggests restraint today. Not every feeling needs to be sent. Sometimes the strongest signal is a steady, dignified quiet that lets them feel your absence. Give the space room to do its quiet work.

rebound.summary: Forgiving the past frees your future today.
rebound.full_text: Whether or not you reunite, Temperance asks you to make peace with it. Resentment ties you to what was; release unties you toward what's next. Today, choose the lighter road. Your heart travels better without the weight.

rebound.summary: A small kindness — to them or yourself — shifts everything.
rebound.full_text: The Empress favors gentleness today, and it starts with you. Be soft with your own heart first. From that steadier place, any reach toward them lands cleaner and any letting-go hurts less. Kindness is the compass now.
